newsitem.title: USA: Oppenheimer Funds chairman Fossel resigns.
newsitem.headline: Oppenheimer Funds chairman Fossel resigns.

text.p: Oppenheimer Funds Inc said chairman Jon Fossel was resigning as chairman, effective Oct 31.

An Oppenheimer spokesman said the mutual fund company has no plans to name a new chairman. The highest ranking official at Oppenheimer Funds is Bridget Macaskill, president and chief executive officer.

Fossel, who also resigned as chairman of the Investment Company Institute trade group last week, said in a statement that he has been planning his resignation for some time because of a "longstanding desire for greater involvement in the public arena."
He said he would become principal and co-host of a weekly television program, "Invest America," which is to be marketed to public television stations over the next several months.
